title: Tech Note: Automatic Output and Input Forms
author: Tai Bui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The specific component fills a gap created by project mode itself (loss of the old binary-mode auto-generated input/output forms), and remains a valid, still-usable utility; its coding style (var declarations, ORDA notation) reflects best practice that is now even more standard in current 4D.
related_updates: Binary mode's automatic input/output form generation for tables with no defined forms was intentionally dropped in project mode due to ORDA's paradigm shift and the preference for listbox-based UIs over classic list forms — this component is a community/support-provided replacement for that lost convenience.

The modern `var $x : Type` declaration syntax shown here (vs. classic C_TEXT/C_LONGINT compiler directives) has become the standard, recommended style in current 4D code, so this note's coding conventions remain exemplary rather than dated.
